Folds a node so its children are hidden. They keep existing, and [ExpandTreeViewNode](ExpandTreeViewNode) shows them again. A node deep in the tree is only seen when everything above it is open.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win  = CreateWindow("Fold", 10, 10, 300, 200, Desktop(), 3)
tree = CreateTreeView(10, 10, 270, 140, win)
a = AddTreeViewNode("Branch", TreeViewRoot(tree))
AddTreeViewNode "Leaf", a
ExpandTreeViewNode a
CollapseTreeViewNode a
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
@param node  Handle of a node.
